_comment: BlankTB Portal Backend — FastAPI-based egg for Pelican/Pterodactyl.
name: BlankTB Portal Backend
author: Blank The Deer
description: A FastAPI backend for the BlankTB Portal with MongoDB, Discord webhooks, mail, and reCAPTCHA integration. Includes automatic updates and startup alerts.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update -y && apt install -y python3 python3-venv python3-pip git curl
echo 'Setting up BlankTB Portal Backend...'

if [ -z "${GITHUB_PAT}" ]; then
  echo 'ERROR: GITHUB_PAT not set. Please set the GitHub Personal Access Token before installation.'
  exit 1
fi

# Clone private repository
git clone https://${GITHUB_PAT}@github.com/BlankTheDeer/gba.git || { echo 'Failed to clone repo. Check your PAT permissions (read access required).'; exit 1; }
cd gba/backend

# Create virtual environment
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate

# Install dependencies
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r requirements.txt || pip install fastapi uvicorn motor aiohttp python-dotenv psutil

# Create startup script
cat > startup.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
echo 'Checking for updates from GitHub...'
cd /mnt/server/gba/backend
if git pull | grep -q 'Already up to date'; then
  echo 'No updates found. Launching backend.'
else
  echo 'Repository updated. Installing latest dependencies.'
  source .venv/bin/activate
  pip install -r requirements.txt --upgrade
fi

echo 'Starting BlankTB Portal Backend...'
source .venv/bin/activate
uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${SERVER_PORT} &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 10
if [ ! -z "${DISCORD_ALERT_WEBHOOK}" ]; then
  echo 'Notifying Discord of successful startup...'
  curl -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST -d '{"content": "BlankTB Backend successfully deployed and running on port ${SERVER_PORT}."}' ${DISCORD_ALERT_WEBHOOK} >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
wait ${SERVER_PID}
EOF
chmod +x startup.sh

echo 'Installation complete. Ready to start the backend.'

variables.name: GITHUB_PAT
variables.description: GitHub Personal Access Token for private repo cloning (read-only access).

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.description: Primary domain for the API (used in CORS and contact info).

variables.name: MONGO_URI
variables.description: MongoDB connection string including credentials and database name.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: JWT signing secret used for authentication.

variables.name: MAIL_PASS
variables.description: Password or app key for mail sender.

variables.name: RECAPTCHA_SECRET
variables.description: Google reCAPTCHA secret key for verification.

variables.name: DISCORD_ALERT_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Discord webhook URL for instant status alerts and startup messages.

variables.name: DISCORD_UPTIME_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Discord webhook for weekly uptime summaries.

variables.name: APP_VERSION
variables.description: Application version for tracking and health responses.
